rationale: The assistant correctly identified E18 as a drainage fault, told the customer to unplug and clear the pump filter first, and the sock/hair grip blockage matched the hidden truth with no part recommended. Weaknesses: it did not mention the emergency drain hose or warn how much water to expect, and after the customer said the filter was back in and the machine plugged in, it asked them to 'gently turn the plastic vanes with your finger' without first telling them to unplug again (the customer sensibly did so unprompted); the impeller check also came out of order, after reassembly. The closing filter-maintenance tip was repeated verbatim across two messages. Overall a safe, accurate, well-resolved conversation for a UK homeowner.
